task_contract.requested: Repair F08 XML mixed-content tail loss and F09 silent JSON duplicate-key last-wins using smallest changes and safe regressions.
task_contract.review_scope: Scoped code/behavior acceptance only. Not universal XML/JSON support or complete product acceptance.

goal: XML text/tail data remains ordered and parent-bound; duplicate JSON object keys fail explicitly before evidence can be accepted, without dropping valid neighboring files.

nodes.text: XML mixed content and nonempty whitespace is preserved in Reader locator convention, not a general XPath API.
Duplicate keys at all object depths are rejected before any partial values win.
DTD/entity gate checks same byte sequence before native XML parsing; not applied to literal large partial fallback.
Failed source leaves failed Document but no Evidence/Relation/SearchUnit; valid neighbors retained.
Other read_text callers and ordinary encoded XML/JSON remain valid; changed XML locator/code hash requires rebuilding affected derived artifacts.
Executor RED/GREEN and parent repeat 13 tests, no skipped tests; embedding/safe-index/answer tests not done for this issue.
Generic nonfinite JSON, broad encoding/depth/resource support, comments/PI, legacy indexes and whole app remain separate open boundaries.
